purpose: Exploratory Monday recovery: train-only verified proof distillation, supervised control, then KL-regularized Lean GRPO. Prepared protocol, not launch approval.
initial_policy: Immutable EXP-020 common_sft checkpoint; resolve and record its weights digest before launch
prerequisites: Freeze train-only collection membership outside DEV, validation, test, and existing near-duplicate exclusions
Collect whole-proof samples with probe_nt_pool.py and the adopted v11 scorer with context fixes
Build inputs/rft using build_rft_data.py; require nonempty train and loss-validation files; create sft_train.jsonl and sft_val.jsonl aliases for run_sft.py
Preserve the original collection verdicts and generation budget, including rejected samples
Record resolved inputs, scorer identity, model digest, source snapshot, costs, and launch approval
inference_boundary: SFT versus RFT matches optimizer steps, not target tokens. RFT versus RFT_GRPO measures an added training stage; it does not isolate KL or RL from all continued-training effects. Select checkpoints on DEV only. Report assisted training and unassisted proof evaluation separately.
